item.title: Simplify: A Strategy for Dramatically Improving Work and Life
item.description: Adopting a simpler approach has greatly enhanced productivity and personal satisfaction, both at Axios and in daily routines.

item.title: Suspected AI use becomes a stigma in the entertainment industry
item.description: Any hint of generative AI usage is increasingly seen as a career risk in creative fields, turning into a purity test that can overshadow work.

item.title: Synagogues adopt new security measures as antisemitic attacks rise
item.description: U.S. synagogues are training congregants as volunteer security teams amid record antisemitic incidents and growing concerns for Jewish gatherings.

item.title: Senate passes stopgap bill to avoid pre-election shutdown
item.description: The Senate approved a stopgap spending bill early Saturday to fund the government through Dec. 11, reducing the risk of a shutdown before elections.
